Avery Cole: Quick: assembling release note for patch v2026.05.1. Canary 09:45 PT, rollout 10:15 PT. Draft: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-05-1
Nora Patel (Ops): Need exact model pin + commit and a short rollback matrix. Ops wants an explicit fallback model.
Avery Cole: Pin block: model_bundle=rbw-fast-0501, commit=1f2d3c4, runtime=snap-256. Adding to draft.
Ibrahim Ali (Perf): Recommend rollback triggers: p50>400ms, error_rate+0.7%, or any OOM. Also run a mixed-length canary (25% long).
Priya Singh (Oncall): I'll be oncall 08:00-12:00 PT and will run checklist. If triggers hit, I'll authorize rollback to rbw-fast-0428 and open runbook RBW-FAST-ROLLBACK.
DocsBot: Keep the internal blast to two lines: canary time + what to watch. Send final blurb and I'll preview.
Avery Cole: Draft blurb for DocsBot: "Internal: Deploy v2026.05.1. Canary 09:45 PT, rollout 10:15 PT. Model pinned to rbw-fast-0501 (commit 1f2d3c4). Rollback if p50>400ms or error rate +0.7% or any OOM. Oncall: Priya Singh. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-FAST-ROLLBACK."
Nora Patel: LGTM. Added ops checklist to runbook: preflight queries, KV warm, autoscaler check, smoke prompts.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-05-03T09:45:00-07:00 (requested by Avery Cole). Reminder set 15 minutes prior.
Priya Singh: Will run checklist at 09:25 PT and post status here.
Avery Cole: Thanks everyone  will post final release note after the blast.
